sender_summary: Anke International is a 27-year-old Dubai-based custom display counter and refrigeration manufacturing company specializing in bespoke hospitality equipment. With proven delivery for globally recognized brands like Tim Hortons and Caribou Coffee across the GCC, Anke designs and fabricates display counters, refrigeration units, and food service equipment tailored to the exact operational and brand standards of premium hospitality groups. The team manages end-to-end project execution from consultation through custom fabrication to on-site installation.
receiver_summary: Shrey Mehta is the Director of Food & Beverage at W Muscat, a luxury Marriott International property in Oman. As a senior F&B operational leader, he oversees all dining outlets, bars, in-room dining, and banqueting operations at a flagship W Hotels property. He is responsible for equipment sourcing decisions, outlet fit-out approvals, vendor selection, and maintaining Marriott's luxury brand standards across all food service areas. He is a decision-maker with operational authority over display equipment, food service counters, and specialty refrigeration needs.
outreach_goal: Introduce Anke International's custom commercial display counters as the ideal equipment solution for W Muscat's F&B outlets and secure a discovery conversation about upcoming fit-out, renovation, or equipment upgrade needs
offer: Anke International designs and manufactures custom commercial display counters and refrigeration units built specifically for premium hospitality brands — from luxury hotel buffet counters to patisserie showcases, bar displays, and specialty food service stations. With 27+ years of manufacturing experience and proven delivery for brands like Tim Hortons and Caribou Coffee in the GCC, we offer fully bespoke fabrication, fast project timelines, and post-installation support. For luxury hotel F&B operations, we deliver Marriott-compliant, brand-aligned display solutions tailored to each outlet's aesthetic and operational requirements. Product details: https://ankeintl.com/display/

pain_points: Luxury hotel F&B teams struggle to find GCC-based manufacturers who match premium brand aesthetics AND deliver on tight renovation timelines, Off-the-shelf display counters rarely meet the visual and hygiene standards of 5-star hotel outlets, Sourcing reliable custom fabricators with proven luxury hospitality track records in the region is time-consuming for busy F&B directors
tone: Professional and respectful — from an experienced hospitality equipment specialist to a senior F&B leader, referencing shared understanding of luxury brand standards, practical and consultative without being salesy
